description: Search DocStar's documentation and guides with a natural-language question, e.g. "how do I add a custom domain to my docs?" or "how does sign-in work on my MCP server?". Returns the most relevant passages with their page URLs. Use it for how-to and concept questions about DocStar. To find an API endpoint to call, use get_docstar_api_docs instead.

collectionIds.description: Always send exactly these collection ids, unchanged: they are the documentation sites searched.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "how do I send a WhatsApp template message"

name: search_docstar_docs
